raw_data_policy: Raw analysis files are retained unchanged alongside these presentation tables.

conversions.*_pct_display_width: normalised horizontal coordinate or error multiplied by 100
conversions.*_pct_display_height: normalised vertical coordinate or error multiplied by 100
conversions.*_relative_coordinate_pct: normalised radial coordinate distance multiplied by 100; 100% = 1.0 raw unit
conversions.*_deg: visual-angle degrees, present only when physical display geometry and viewing distance are recorded
